table_attributes.Source Filter:
CPM_NEWPAY_TBL.PP_END_YEAR = TO_NUMBER('$$MAP_PP_END_YEAR')
AND
CPM_NEWPAY_TBL.PP_NUM = TO_NUMBER('$$MAP_PP_NUM')
AND
CPM_NEWPAY_TBL.MP_POOL_DES = ' '
AND
CPM_NEWPAY_TBL.BUSINESS_UNIT = 'OIG00'
--CPM_NEWPAY_TBL.ORG_CDE LIKE 'AF%'

fields.name: v_SUBJECT
fields.expression:
v_ENVIRONMENT ||
'CPM OIG Process Completed Successfully for: ' || 
TO_CHAR(PP_END_YEAR) || '-' || v_PP_NUM

fields.name: v_MESSAGE
fields.expression: 'Total number of CPM OIG records loaded is: ' || TO_CHAR(CPM_OIG_TOTAL)

fields.name: v_ABORT_FLAG
fields.expression:
DECODE(TRUE,

			NOT IS_NUMBER(INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR) AND DEFAULT_TO_CURR_PP_FLAG = FALSE, 
				TRUE,

			NOT IS_NUMBER(INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM) AND DEFAULT_TO_CURR_PP_FLAG = FALSE, 
				TRUE,

			ISNULL(lkp_DFAS_PSEUDO_SSN), 
				TRUE,

                 FALSE)

fields.name: o_ABORT_MESSAGE
fields.expression:
DECODE(TRUE,

                        v_ABORT_FLAG = TRUE AND NOT IS_NUMBER(INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR),
                                 ABORT('!!!! The value : ' || INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR || ' is not a valid pay period year'),

                        v_ABORT_FLAG = TRUE AND NOT IS_NUMBER(INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM),
                                 ABORT('!!!! The value : ' || INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM || ' is not a valid pay period number'),

                        v_ABORT_FLAG = TRUE AND ISNULL(lkp_DFAS_PSEUDO_SSN),
                                 ABORT('!!!! There were no OIG records found for this pay period: ' || INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR || '-' || LPAD(INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM, 2, '0')),

                         FALSE)

table_attributes.Lookup Source Filter:
PP_END_YEAR = TO_NUMBER('$$MAP_PP_END_YEAR')
AND
PP_NUM = TO_NUMBER('$$MAP_PP_NUM')
AND
BUSINESS_UNIT = 'OIG00'
table_attributes.Lookup condition: PP_END_YEAR = in_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR AND PP_NUM = in_PARAM_PP_NUM AND MP_POOL_DES = in_MP_POOL_DES

fields.name: v_DEFAULT_TO_CURR_PP_FLAG
fields.expression:
DECODE(TRUE,

		(ISNULL(INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR) OR IS_SPACES(INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR) OR 
              LENGTH(LTRIM(INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR)) = 0) AND

             (ISNULL(INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM) OR IS_SPACES(INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM) OR
              LENGTH(LTRIM(INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM)) = 0),
                      TRUE,

                  FALSE)

fields.name: v_PP_END_YEAR
fields.expression:
DECODE(TRUE,
                 
				v_DEFAULT_TO_CURR_PP_FLAG = TRUE,
		                     lkp_CURR_PP_END_YEAR,

				v_PAY_PERIOD_PARAM_EXISTS_FLAG = TRUE,
                      		PARAM_PP_END_YEAR
                             )


--IIF(v_PAY_PERIOD_PARAM_EXISTS_FLAG = TRUE,
--                 TO_CHAR(PARAM_PP_END_YEAR),
--                 TO_CHAR(lkp_CURR_PP_END_YEAR))

fields.name: v_PP_NUM
fields.expression:
DECODE(TRUE,
                 
				v_DEFAULT_TO_CURR_PP_FLAG = TRUE,
		                     lkp_CURR_PP_NUM,

				v_PAY_PERIOD_PARAM_EXISTS_FLAG = TRUE,
                      		 PARAM_PP_NUM        
                     )



--IIF(v_PAY_PERIOD_PARAM_EXISTS_FLAG = TRUE,
--        	TO_CHAR(PARAM_PP_NUM),
--	TO_CHAR(lkp_CURR_PP_NUM))
